title: Love it! ❤️
body:
I remembered this app from older version which I loved, but at some point it disappeared from App Store, and I was searching for routine/habits app that would fill the void, but honestly none of apps could. Now I’m more than happy to see it back again in new version, and can’t wait for more features! 

For new users: it has very different UI than all the other apps on the market, so you may need a few moments to catch the workflow, but once you get it you’ll love it!
author: Nithhogg
